Quick items

Choose a belt item, then its target.

Potions and wands may have limited uses. Assign them to the belt in the equipment screen.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Phial with potion

To use a potion or a wand you bought or found you must first hand it over to one of your characters in "camp".
The potion will then be available to the character and will appear in the appropriate framed screen. To use it, just click on its icon or use the following keyboard keys:

Use item 1 - <P> key.
Use item 2 - <O> key.
Use item 3 - <I> key.
Use item 4 - <U> key.
